name: FUN_ADM_TARGET_TABLES
description: This table contains the target object to which the attribute derivation rule output value will be populated.

columns.name: TARGET_TABLE_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence generated identifier for a target table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the application associated with the target table. Used for Accounting Hub where target table could be shared across multiple applications.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the target table of a transaction entity for attribute derivation.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN1
columns.description: Name of first primary key column of the target table, which is mandatory.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN2
columns.description: Name of third primary key column of the target table.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN3
columns.description: Name of third primary key column of the target table.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN4
columns.description: Name of fourth primary key column of the target table.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_COLUMN5
columns.description: Name of fifth primary key column of the target table.

columns.name: ENTITY_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Entity class associated with the target table.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code associated with the target table.

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Entity type code associated with the target table.

columns.name: LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Identifies whether this table is a header, line or distribution level entity of the transaction entity.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
